subject: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@novuscloud.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T09:02:00Z
Subject: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

Team —

Thanks for interviewing Raj Patel (NovusCloud) yesterday. I pulled everyone's raw scorecards into the sheet (attached) and included a compiled notes PDF. We have some divergence on System Design vs. Product tradeoffs that we need to resolve before sending feedback to recruiting.

Quick asks:
- Please drop final numeric scores in column "Final" of the attached sheet by 12:00 PT today.
- If you mark "No Hire", add a 1–2 line rationale (helps recruiting and for calibration).
- If you're leaning "Hire" but have concerns, flag it as "Hire*" and add the risk line item.

Context: two interviewers (Aditya, Alex) are leaning hire, two (Marissa, Karthik) raised concerns on operational breadth. That's a split outcome — we should either pick a tie-breaker or run a 20–30m calibration call.

Attachments: infra-pm-scorecard.xlsx (xlsx), interviewer-notes-compiled.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I'll compile after 12:00 and propose next steps.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

Thanks Mina — I filled my scores. Short summary:
- Final: No Hire
- Main reason: candidate's design examples focused on short-term mitigation patterns rather than owning long-lived distributed system tradeoffs (e.g., long-tail recovery, rollout strategies across heterogeneous infra).
- Concern: product sense around prioritization for infra tech debt felt light — would struggle to represent platform in cross-functional leadership conversations.

I'm happy to do the 20–30m calibration if that helps. Otherwise, I'm comfortable marking No Hire with the above rationale.

— Marissa
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

Filled my numbers in the sheet (Final: Hire). Key points from my side:
- Candidate demonstrated solid debugging and incident leadership (tempers chaos, good postmortem framing).
- Clear proposals on KV-cache and batching prioritization that would materially reduce tail latency for some workloads.
- Risk: not as strong on product-facing stakeholder influence; I'd pair with a stronger PM initially and measure.

Attached my interviewer note (see: infra-pm-aditya-notes.docx) — I uploaded a short extract to the compiled PDF too.

— Aditya
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T13:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

I put Final: No Hire (see sheet). Short clarification on my read:
- The candidate's system examples were solid on low-level ops, but lacked a repeatable framework for cross-team prioritization and OKR-driven tradeoffs. At Redwood we lean heavily on roadmap negotiation with product and infra teams — I'm not confident Raj has the playbook yet.
- Willing to be convinced if Marissa/Aditya provide concrete examples from the interview where the candidate demonstrated roadmap influence.

If people are open, 20 minutes to walk through the same transcript snippets would be quicker than writing long comments. I'm free 15:30–16:00 PT.

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Platform Orchestration

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T14:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

Final: Hire. One extra datapoint: Raj gave a concrete example about negotiating a phased rollout with three dependent teams to reduce blast radius — he explicitly drove metrics (error-rate, deploy lead time) and negotiated cutover windows. I think that meets the "roadmap influence" bar in practice.

If we do a quick call, I can pull that transcript and point to the exact lines. Otherwise, I defer to Mina for tie-break.

— Alex
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@novuscloud.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T16:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Infra PM — alignment & action grid

Thanks all — I compiled the sheet and the current split is 2x Hire / 2x No Hire. Given the split and the product-influence concern, I want a short calibration rather than a unilateral no-hire.

Decision & next steps:
- I'll run a 25-minute calibration call with Marissa, Karthik, and Alex at 15:40 PT tomorrow (2026-04-08) — goal: walk transcript snippets and decide final call.
- Aditya, please hold off on sending any offer signal until we confirm on the call.
- Priya (recruiting), please hold candidate scheduling until we confirm availability — we expect to finalize by end of day tomorrow.
- Post-call: I will own final note to NovusCloud with consolidated rationale and the agreed outcome.

If anyone cannot make the 15:40 slot, reply now and we'll adjust; otherwise I'll send a calendar invite.

— Mina
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
